External observed/null statistic maps

Source: R/null_factories.R
null_from_maps.Rd

Wraps an observed statistic map and externally generated null maps in a null_spec. This is the generic bridge for MVPA, searchlight, PLS, ASCA, or any workflow that already has matched observed and permuted statistic maps.

Usage

null_from_maps(
  stat_vol,
  null_maps,
  mask = NULL,
  kind = "external_maps",
  meta = list()
)

Arguments

stat_vol

Observed canonicalized Z-equivalent statistic map.

null_maps

Null maps. Accepts a list of 3D maps, a 4D array whose fourth dimension indexes permutations, or a numeric matrix with one row per permutation and either sum(mask) or prod(dim(stat_vol)) columns.

mask

Optional logical 3D mask. Defaults to finite voxels in stat_vol.

kind

Character kind tag for the resulting null_spec.

meta

Optional named metadata list.

Value

A null_spec with deterministic draw(b) over supplied maps.
